Hava Nagila 2026 version will be in the style of Bill Frisell, with harmonics in the intro. The song is played thoughtfully, one phrase at a time without rushing, as if talking to somebody and softly emphasizing the message of the tune.

{{< video https://youtu.be/54o3euq7viE >}}
